# SEmptyState `<s-empty-state>`

Explains why a view has no content yet and points merchants to the first action to take. `SEmptyState` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-empty-state>` web component.

```ts
import { SEmptyState } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Explain the cause, then the fix.** A bare "No products" heading leaves merchants guessing. Use the `heading` to say why nothing is there, and let the action carry the next step.
- **Lead with one primary action.** Use the `primary-action` slot for the one step that gets merchants out of the empty state, and place other options in `secondary-actions`.
- **Word filtered results differently.** A resource with nothing in it and a filter that matched nothing are different situations. For filtered results, tell merchants how to adjust the filter.
- **Treat the graphic as extra.** The heading and action do the work, so leave the `graphic` slot empty in dense layouts, and when you do use it, limit it to one icon or image.

```vue
<SEmptyState heading="You haven't added any products yet">
  <template #primary-action>
    <SButton variant="primary">Add product</SButton>
  </template>
  <template #secondary-actions>
    <SButton>Import products</SButton>
  </template>
</SEmptyState>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-empty-state>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/feedback-and-status-indicators/empty-state#best-practices) for the full guidance.

## Example

<script setup>
import SEmptyStateDemo from '../examples/demos/SEmptyStateDemo.vue'
</script>

<div class="demo-surface">

<SEmptyStateDemo />

</div>

```vue
<script setup>
import { SEmptyState, SButton, SIcon, SText, SLink } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SEmptyState heading="No orders yet">
    <template #graphic>
      <SIcon type="cart" size="large" />
    </template>
    <template #subheading>
      <SText>Once a customer places an order, it will show up here. <SLink href="https://help.shopify.com/orders" target="_blank">Learn more about orders</SLink></SText>
    </template>
    <template #primary-action>
      <SButton variant="primary">Create order</SButton>
    </template>
    <template #secondary-actions>
      <SButton variant="secondary">Import orders</SButton>
    </template>
  </SEmptyState>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string` | The heading of the EmptyState. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `graphic` | An illustration or symbol shown above the heading. Accepts a single `Image` or `Icon`, either directly or as the only child of a wrapping element. |
| `primary-action` | The main call to action, rendered below the text content. Accepts a single `Button` with a `variant` of `primary`; anything else is ignored with a development warning. |
| `secondary-actions` | An alternative action, rendered beside the primary one. Accepts a single `Button` with a `variant` of `secondary` or `auto` — despite the plural name, only one is rendered. |
| `subheading` | Supporting text below the heading, explaining what's missing or what to do next. Accepts `Text` and `Link` components. |
